title: Victory Bay Charters
specs: Target species include Redfish, Speckled Trout, Black Drum, Bay Snapper, Flounder, and Bass
Possible wildlife sightings include alligators and dolphins
Fishing license required, can be purchased online at Louisiana Wildlife & Fisheries
Wear appropriate clothing for the season and weather; hat and sunglasses recommended
Boat capacity up to 6 passengers plus captain (OUPV license)
Typically no more than 4 adults per boat; 5 or 6 possible for families with children
For groups larger than 4 adults, additional boats are used to keep groups together
includes: Cleaning and bagging of catch at marina
blurb: Guests board a boat at Lake Catherine area in New Orleans and fish for species like Redfish, Speckled Trout, Black Drum, Bay Snapper, Flounder, and Bass. Trips include scenic navigation through coastal marshes with possible wildlife sightings such as alligators and dolphins. Catch is cleaned and bagged at the marina.
extraNote: Captain decides on cancellation due to weather after 6pm forecast the night before · No fishing through lightning storms or heavy rain · Lake Catherine area in New Orleans
